title: A post across WR-90 from a SolidCraft design, its diameter set to 4 mm when opened (the design's parameter `d`, 3 mm as saved): adaptive passes from 6 mm until ΔS < 3e-3, at 10 GHz
source: The full-height post is a two-dimensional problem: the parallel-plate Green's function in modes with its static part summed in closed form (Marcuvitz, Waveguide Handbook, 1951, §5.11; Lewin, Theory of Waveguides, 1975, ch. 6), the first-kind integral equation on the post solved by Kress's log-split Nyström method (Kress, Linear Integral Equations, 3rd ed., 2014, ch. 12–13), evaluated at 128 nodes for a 4 mm post (emcraft-theory::post, independent of the finite elements; `cargo run -p emcraft-theory --example post_reference -- 4`)

quantities.reason: the design's exact cylinder and the same adaptive recipe as imported-post; what is left is discretisation
